_note: Messages shown to people. English is the reference: every other language file must have exactly these keys. Text is written out whole, one message per key, because grammar differs between languages; do not build sentences by joining fragments. {name} marks a value filled in by the application. Variants of a word are separate variables: {side} agrees with a feminine noun, {side_m} with a masculine one.

progress.note.1: Each dot is the furthest angle reached in one session, drawn against the range prescribed that day (green band). Green dots ended inside it. For flexion a smaller angle is further.
progress.note.2: Home sessions were done by the patient alone with the application, clinic sessions under supervision. Repetitions are shown against the number prescribed where a home programme applied. Pain (0 to 10) and effort are the patient's own answers after a home session.
progress.note.3: This system has not been validated against a reference measurement method. The figures are for demonstration and are not a clinical measurement, a diagnosis, or an impairment rating.
progress.note.privacy: Video frames were processed in memory and were not written to disk. This report contains joint angle summaries and the patient's own answers only.
pdf.title: Session report
pdf.subtitle: Movement measurement summary
pdf.doc.title: {brand} session report
pdf.reps.summary: Repetitions  -  {in_target} of {n} ended inside the prescribed range
pdf.reps.summary.past: Repetitions  -  {in_target} of {n} ended inside the prescribed range, {past} went past it
pdf.chart.caption.lower: peak angle per repetition, degrees (lower is further)
pdf.chart.caption.higher: peak angle per repetition, degrees (higher is further)
pdf.notes.title: How to read this report
pdf.note.1: Angles are computed from joint positions estimated by a camera. Readings depend on camera placement, distance, lighting and clothing, and a measurement is withheld rather than shown when landmark quality is insufficient.
pdf.note.2: Repetitions counts every repetition that reached the prescribed range. "In target" counts those whose furthest point ended inside it; a repetition that went past the range is still counted, but not as in target. Furthest angle is the furthest point reached in the session, not a measure of quality.
pdf.note.3: Time in target is the share of measured frames that fell inside the prescribed range. It describes how the session was performed, not the accuracy of the measurement.
pdf.note.4: This system has not been validated against a reference measurement method. The figures above are for demonstration and are not a clinical measurement, a diagnosis, or an impairment rating.
pdf.note.privacy: Video frames were processed in memory and were not written to disk. This report contains joint angle summaries only.
